About the role:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to lead the architecture of our real-time collaboration platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement scalable distributed web applications
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and pair programming
- Collaborate closely with product management and designers to refine specifications
- Drive architectural improvements across our core services

Requirements:
- Required: 5+ years of experience with TypeScript and modern React
- Required: 4+ years building backend microservices with Node.js
- Required: Strong experience with relational databases and SQL optimization
- Required: Proven track record of mentoring and technical leadership
- Bonus: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS
- Nice-to-have: Familiarity with WebSockets, real-time messaging, and Redis

Software Developer

Join our passionate team building next-generation developer tooling. Work hard, ship fast.
